root_cause.text: The `ip_options_get` function in the IPv4 networking stack lacked a capability validation check, allowing unprivileged users to configure Strict Source and Record Route (SSRR) or Loose Source and Record Route (LSRR) IP options.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the condition `if (opt->opt.srr && !ns_capable(net->user_ns, CAP_NET_RAW))` within `net/ipv4/ip_options.c` to return `-EPERM`, directly addressing the CVE description stating that unprivileged applications could previously force packets to route through attacker-controlled nodes to leak protocol information.
